SMRITI · स्मृति · APP FLOW AND UI MOCKS

Every screen, from first launch to the mock report

Draft mocks in the Sunny Subjects style for the mobile apps and the web app. Each frame carries its screen ID from the specs in docs/ux/. Illustrations are draft Agnes AI images; the mascots and plant still need the owner's approval. Sign-in is Google only, with Sign in with Apple added on iPhone.

Entry and onboarding

From the splash to Home in about three minutes (R27): language, then a few quick questions, a buddy and a seed in about 30–45 seconds, then a real 2-minute first lesson, the first win, the daily goal and the reminder ask. The streak check-in sheet for returning students closes the section.

Specs: docs/ux/onboarding.md (v0.3) · Flow: docs/flows/onboarding.md · Rulings R27, R40, R41, R42

Sign-in and accounts

Guest first, then one tap on Google when saving matters. iPhone adds Sign in with Apple under Google at the same size; Android and web are Google only. Covers linking, merge, sign out, delete, guardian consent for 13 to 17, parent sign-in for under-13s, errors and the web page. Every login surface carries the trust line and only Google's approved label.

Specs: docs/ux/auth.md · Flow: docs/flows/auth.md · Research: docs/research/COMPETITOR_FLOWS.md §11

Soft login sheet

AUTH-01 rises 1.2 s after the lesson-complete counts finish. Reason lesson_3. It is the only prompt on this lesson complete (R15) and is rationed by the soft-wall budget (R29).

Hard login sheet

AUTH-02 is full height and always closable. After sign-in it closes and the pending action resumes in place.

Google handoff and welcome

Google's own UI runs first. Our sheet then shows a waiting state, and the result screens say plainly what happened.

Account management

Sign out clears this phone for the next person (shared phones). Delete has a 7-day grace period.

Guardian consent (13 to 17)

A teen's guardian says yes with their own Google account, on the same phone or through a link. The guardian side drops the pet and speaks to an adult.

Parents and children

Under-13s never sign in with Google. A parent signs in with their own account and owns the child's account.

Errors and other states

AUTH-30 replaces the buttons inside the sheet that was already open; it is never a new sheet. Cancel in Google's UI is not an error.

Web sign-in

AUTH-29 at app.<domain>/login. The button is rendered by Google (continue_with, pill, outline); One Tap runs here and on the guardian landing only.

Home and lessons

Home with its plan-driven hero card, the path strip, subjects, chapters, topic cards and the lesson player. "Locked" only ever means Pro, and a locked item always opens to a preview. Lesson text and questions here are neutral placeholders; real content comes from the content skills.

Specs: docs/ux/learn.md · Flow: docs/flows/learn.md · Rulings R9, R10, R11, R14, R15, R16, R28

Memory and labs

Reviews with Again / Hard / Good / Easy and Sure / 50:50 / Guess, the comeback plan, the 2-minute rescue, decks, palaces, the hook forge, the confidence dashboard and focus timer; then the Labs hub, sims, 3D, 360°, the periodic table and home experiments. Memory is not a tab (R17): it opens from Home, so its screens keep Learn active. Every lab is free (R19 revised); Pro chips (P2: primary tint, lock, the word Pro, never gold) appear only on palace building, the AI hook forge, audio hooks and sleep review.

Specs: docs/ux/memory-labs.md · Flow: docs/flows/memory-labs.md · Rulings R11, R17–R22, R28, R37

Practice and mock tests

The Practice tab: the hub, concept drills, the PYQ bank, the daily challenge and analytics, then the mock test journey from the lobby through the deliberately plain, exam-like runner to the report. Every exam pattern value is a blueprint placeholder; nothing here states a real duration, marking scheme or question count.

Specs: docs/ux/practice.md · Flow: docs/flows/practice.md · Rulings R21, R23–R26, R31, R43, R44

AI tutor and friends

The pet tutor on every study screen (chat, pictures, voice, photo doubts, stories, role play and Teach it back), then the Friends tab: leagues named after plants, Duo streaks, squads and duels. Friends never type to each other: only preset cheers. Under-18s appear to others only by pet name and pet avatar.

Specs: docs/ux/tutor-social.md · Flow: docs/flows/tutor-social.md · Rulings R3, R20, R28, R30–R32

Me, Pro and notifications

The Me tab (pet, plant, badges, shop, quests, downloads), Settings and Parent mode, the ₹1 Pro offer from paywall to checkout and plan management, and the push notifications and home-screen widgets.
